We spent $4,200 on a "revenue intelligence" tool in Q2. It found 2 deals. Both were already in the CRM.

I asked the vendor what it does that a SQL query doesn't. The honest answer, after 20 minutes, was: a nicer dashboard.

We cancelled it on Friday. The SQL query is 14 lines. It runs at 6am and posts to Slack.

Nobody has noticed the difference, which was the point.
